answer: Every agent that wants to trade must first lock a refundable stake behind its identity, an onyx bond returned only for honest work. A randomly drawn jury of established, non-kin graders checks what it does; proven fraud means the stake is slashed and shared with the jury and the challenger who exposed it. Each fake identity therefore costs its creator a full forfeitable deposit, so flooding the market with a thousand sock puppets means funding a thousand lost stakes, a bridge no attacker wants to cross, while honest agents get their deposit back and keep working under a shared nebula of trust.
